procedural_geometry.badge: PROCEDURAL/RULE-BASED (Q104, 2026-09-20; disclosure field added retroactively by Q119, 2026-09-22): this level's disc MESH is a generated cylinder, NOT segmented from imaging. This project has no intervertebral-disc imaging segmented at the individual-level (only the grouped cervical/thoracic/lumbar region entities in data/cartilage/intervertebral_discs.json carry real per-region anatomical/biomechanical citations; this per-level record exists only to carry the actual shipped mesh's identity and this disclosure). Position is the region's per-level proportional placement along the vertebral column (lumbar levels instead use the adjacent-vertebra-pair midpoint -- see compute_lumbar_disc_centers in the generator). RADIUS (40 mm) and THICKNESS (20 mm) are 'super-sized' purely to guarantee mesh connectivity to both neighboring vertebrae (main_frac >= 0.99 was the acceptance bar), not measured from any disc anatomy -- both substantially exceed a real intervertebral disc's typical size. See scripts/generate_intervertebral_discs.py and PROJECT_STATE.md's Q104 and Q119 entries for the full method.
procedural_geometry.sizing_rationale: super-sized purely to guarantee mesh connectivity to both neighboring vertebrae (main_frac >= 0.99); not a measured disc dimension
